kurzbeschreibung: The Schaubergwerk Kupferplatte in Jochberg offers fascinating insights into centuries of Tyrolean copper mining tradition, complete with an authentic mine railway ride.
beschreibung:
Traditional Copper Mining in the Kitzbüheler Alpen

The Schaubergwerk Kupferplatte in Jochberg brings more than 500 years of mining history in the Kitzbühel region to life. In the Kelchalpe district, valuable copper ore was once mined underground, decisively shaping the economic development of the valley.

Underground Experience with the Historic Mine Railway

A highlight of the guided tour is the ride aboard the authentic Grubenbahn mine train deep into the tunnels. Along the walking route, display cabinets, historic drilling equipment, and blasting techniques vividly showcase the hard labour of miners from centuries past.
